title: OmniPad 1.4.0 - Universal Cross-Platform Release (Windows, Linux, macOS, Android, iOS)
notes: Full five-platform ecosystem: Windows portable server (WHQL kernel + direct HID), Linux kernel /dev/uinput virtual gamepad engine, macOS universal host server (CoreGraphics CGEvent + DSU motion), native Android client APK, and native iOS client IPA (SwiftUI, CoreHaptics, volume bumpers, NWConnection UDP 250 Hz).
